podcast.body: In the fall of 1998, Lauryn Hill made her celebrated solo debut with "Doo Wop (That Thing)," which launched straight to number one. This achievement came after the success of her former rap troupe, The Fugees, and solidified her status as a megastar with significant cultural clout. "Lauren Hill, making her celebrated solo debut after the success of her former rap troupe, The Fuji's, debuted at number 1 with her first single Do-Wop, that thing."
